scope: One additional rank-1 boundary between the two left-associated state-update additions.
description: Register fp_add(old2, prev2) as update_partial, and carry now2 and Q through matching registers. On the next cycle compute fp_add(update_partial, update_now). Extend the rank-1 valid/address pipeline by one cycle and shift every downstream state-write/product/accumulator consumer together. The testbench independently checks address, delayed now2 and Q for every partial sum, and resets with this stage valid before writeback. No addition is reassociated.
